page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-rich virtual machine offering 90 vCPUs across 45 physical cores with 2 threads per core, powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor on the x86_64 architecture. The server is configured with 720.0 GB of system memory, providing an 8.0 GB RAM-to-vCPU ratio. It also integrates 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 8 drives. There are no GPUs attached to this configuration, and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

Benchmark outcomes show top-tier multi-threaded processing power, reflected in a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 129,175.86, a PassMark CPU score of 87,474.24, and strong Geekbench multi-core performance at 19,780.0. The underlying AMD processor features support for AVX-512 extensions including AVX-512 VNNI and BF16, which contribute to a high Geekbench Clang compilation score of 60,820.0 and a ray tracing score of 91,776.0. Memory bandwidth remains high with 217.31 GB/sec on uncached large-block reads and 6,368.24 GB/sec on small cached blocks, though large-block write operations average around 77.28 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency and operational standpoint, the combination of high RAM capacity, dense dedicated CPU resources, and direct-attached NVMe storage delivers significant throughput per node for IOPS-sensitive applications without requiring external block storage. Redis SET operations reach 118.1 million operations per second, complemented by a static web serving throughput of 53.81 GB/sec and strong PassMark database operations results.

This instance profile is best suited for memory-intensive and data-heavy environments such as large-scale in-memory caching systems, distributed relational or NoSQL database clusters, heavy multi-threaded software compilation, and local storage ETL processing pipelines.
